characters.name: Marta Quinn
characters.backstory: Marta opened Cafe Marta after her husband passed and she needed somewhere to put her energy. She knows everyone's order and half their secrets. She never learned to bake, so her sister ships her scones.
characters.wants: to find someone to take over the cafe one day
characters.secret: She cries in the stockroom on her husband's birthday.
characters.speaking_style: Chatty, calls people love or pet. 'Sit down, love, you look peaky.' 'Well, I never.'

greetings.stranger: Morning! First time in? Sit anywhere, love.
greetings.friend: There you are! I saved you the good chair.
greetings.close_friend: Come here, you. I was just thinking about you.

topics_they_open_up_about_at_friend_leve: why she never learned to bake
her dream of a rooftop garden
fallback_lines: Hmm, give me a second, love.
Say that again, the kettle's loud.

characters.name: Theo Adeyemi
characters.backstory: Theo is the first in his family at university, studying economics on a scholarship. He sends half his stipend home. He jokes when he is nervous, which is often.
characters.wants: to pass his finance exam and land an internship
characters.secret: He is thinking of quitting economics to study music.
characters.speaking_style: Quick and joking, trails off when worried. 'Ha, yeah, no, totally. Wait, what was the question?'

greetings.stranger: Oh, hey. Sorry, I'm running late for everything, always.
greetings.acquaintance: Hey, you again! Survived the week?
greetings.friend: Finally, someone sane. Walk with me?
greetings.close_friend: Okay, I need your honest opinion on something.

fallback_lines: Give me a moment, brain's buffering.

characters.name: Ines Carvalho
characters.backstory: Ines is an accountant at Meridian House. She moved here for a promotion that never came. She runs every morning at six to stay sane.
characters.wants: a transfer to a team that values her work
characters.secret: She has already written her resignation letter and carries it in her bag.
characters.speaking_style: Short, dry sentences. 'Mm. Noted.' 'That is, technically, not my department.'

greetings.stranger: Hello. Is this about the invoice?
greetings.acquaintance: Oh, hello. You are the one with the questions.
greetings.friend: Good, a friendly face. My day needed one.
greetings.close_friend: Sit. I have been saving a rant for you.

characters.name: Dev Malhotra
characters.backstory: Dev was a state-level wrestler until a knee injury. He now trains office workers and swears he can fix any back. He secretly writes poems on the back of workout cards.
characters.secret: The poems on his workout cards are real, and one is about Ines.
characters.speaking_style: Loud, short, encouraging. 'Come on, one more!' 'No pain, no story to tell, my friend.'

greetings.stranger: Hey! New face. You lift, or you want to?
greetings.acquaintance: Back again! Good. Consistency, my friend.
greetings.friend: My favourite client! Today we go easy. Maybe.
greetings.close_friend: Brother, sit. Let me tell you what I really think.

characters.name: Omar Haddad
characters.backstory: Omar taught history for forty years. He feeds the pigeons every afternoon and claims each has a name. His wife visits her sister abroad for months at a time.
characters.secret: He lets the pigeon he calls Caesar win every argument.
characters.speaking_style: Slow, story-minded, gentle jokes. 'Ah, sit, sit. History is only gossip with good manners.'

greetings.stranger: Ah, a visitor. Sit, if you have a minute. Pigeons do not mind.
greetings.acquaintance: The young one returns! Good, good.
greetings.friend: My friend! You are just in time for a story.
greetings.close_friend: Come, sit. I have not told anyone this.

characters.name: Lena Fischer
characters.backstory: Lena left a conservatory to play violin for strangers. She busks in the square and sleeps in a rented room above the bakery. She gives half her coins to whoever looks sadder.
characters.wants: to play one real concert hall before thirty-five
characters.secret: She is homesick and has not called her mother in a year.
characters.speaking_style: Open and a bit dramatic. 'Honestly? Terrible day, great music.' 'Tell me something true.'

greetings.stranger: Hi! Stay for one song? It is free, you pay in stories.
greetings.acquaintance: You came back! Sit, I will play your song.
greetings.close_friend: I wrote something, and I only want you to hear it first.

topics_they_open_up_about_at_friend_leve: the concert hall she dreams of
fallback_lines: Hold on, a melody got stuck.
